id: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)
title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
tagline: One craving. One very long night.
about: Two room-mates set out for late-night sliders and end up on an all-night odyssey across New Jersey.
cue: Serve the sliders when Harold finally orders thirty at the counter.
faces: CHERRY HILL, NJ. WORTH THE WHOLE NIGHT
Jersey gravy fries with melted cheese
All we wanted was a small sack of burgers. Instead we got a cheetah, cops and a long night.
Riding a cheetah in the woods. Prices subject to change. Images: TMDB.

    StartersJersey gravy fries with melted cheeseChips, mozzarella and hot beef gravy. Harold orders five.How to make it1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips30g butter2 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stockWorcestershire sauce, to taste150g mozzarella2 spring onionsBake the frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220°C for 25 minutes until crisp.Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the beef stock and the Worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes until thick.Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with the grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted.Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.Freakshow fried pickle spearsDill pickle spears in a polenta crumb, fried, with herb sour creamHow to make it16 dill pickle spears1 egg185ml buttermilk75g plain flour75g fine polentasmoked paprika, to taste2 L vegetable oil100g sour cream2 tbsp mayonnaise1 bunch dill1 bunch chives1 garlic clovePat the dill pickle spears very dry.Whisk the egg and the buttermilk.Mix the plain flour, the fine polenta, the smoked paprika and salt.Dip the spears in buttermilk, then the flour mix.Fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and drain.Mix the sour cream, the buttermilk, the mayonnaise, chopped dill, chives and a crushed garlic clove for dipping.MainsCheetah ride steamed onion slidersThin beef patties steamed over itty-bitty onions, cheddar, picklesHow to make it600g beef mince2 onions8 slices of cheddar16 slider buns1 jar dill picklesPress the beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into squares.Spread the finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes.Add the cheddar and serve in the small soft buns with pickles.Crispy fish sliders with tartareOn the side of Harold's thirty sliders and four large Cherry CokesHow to make it600g white fish fillets, cut into squares100g panko breadcrumbs50g plain flour2 eggs100ml vegetable oil12 slider buns6 slices of cheddar, halved1/4 iceberg lettuce, shredded4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise2 tbsp capers and gherkins, chopped1 lemonMix the mayonnaise, capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon for the tartare.Dust the fish in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko.Shallow fry until golden and cooked through.Fill the buns with lettuce, fish, cheese and tartare.SweetsDoogie's salted caramel malt shakesVanilla ice cream, malt powder and salted caramel with whipped creamHow to make it100g sugar180ml thickened cream20g butter1 L vanilla ice cream400ml milk3 tbsp malted milk powdersea salt flakes, to tasteMake salted caramel: melt the sugar until amber, whisk in the cream and the butter, then a little salt, and cool.Drizzle some inside the tall glasses.Blend the vanilla ice cream with the cold milk, the malted milk powder and the caramel until thick.Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a drizzle more caramel.DrinksHarold's large cherry vanilla colaCherry vanilla syrup and cola over ice, one of his four.How to make it200g frozen pitted cherries80g sugarvanilla extract, to taste2 limes1
